1: // Simple Meteor Dodger game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: // Enhanced graphics: starfield background, ship as triangle, meteors with radial gradient.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Ensure canvas has explicit size
9:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
10:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
11: 
12:   // Starfield background
13:   const stars = [];
14:   for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
15:     stars.push({
16:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
17:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
18:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
19:     });
20:   }
21: 
22:   const ship = {
23:     w: 40,
24:     h: 20,
25:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
26:     y: canvas.height - 30,
27:     speed: 4,
28:   };
29:   const keys = {};
30:   // Audio setup
31:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
32:   let moveSoundPlaying = false;
33:   function playBeep(freq, dur) {
34:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
35:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
36:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
37:     osc.type = 'square';
38:     osc.connect(gain);
39:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
40:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
41:     osc.start();
42:     setTimeout(() => {
43:       osc.stop();
44:     }, dur);
45:   }
46:   function playMove() {
47:     if (!moveSoundPlaying) {
48:       moveSoundPlaying = true;
49:       playBeep(200, 100);
50:       setTimeout(() => moveSoundPlaying = false, 100);
51:     }
52:   }
53:   function playExplosion() {
54:     playBeep(100, 300);
55:     playBeep(150, 200);
56:     playBeep(200, 100);
57:   }
58:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
59:     keys[e.key] = true;
60:     // resume audio context on first interaction
61:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
62:     if (['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown'].includes(e.key)) playMove();
63:   });
64:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
65: 
66:   const meteors = [];
67:   let meteorTimer = 0;
68:   let score = 0;
69:   let gameOver = false;
70: 
71:   function spawnMeteor() {
72:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
73:     meteors.push({
74:       x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
75:       y: -size,
76:       r: size / 2,
77:       speed: Math.random() * 2 + 2,
78:     });
79:   }
80: 
81:   function update() {
82:     // ship movement
83:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
84:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
85:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
86:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
87:     // keep inside canvas
88:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.w, ship.x));
89:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.h, ship.y));
90: 
91:     // starfield scroll
92:     for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
93:       const s = stars[i];
94:       s.y += 0.5; // slow downward drift
95:       if (s.y > canvas.height) {
96:         s.y = 0;
97:         s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
98:       }
99:     }
100: 
101:     // meteors
102:     meteorTimer++;
103:     if (meteorTimer > 30) { // spawn roughly every half‑second
104:       spawnMeteor();
105:       meteorTimer = 0;
106:     }
107:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
108:       const m = meteors[i];
109:       m.y += m.speed;
110:       // remove off‑screen
111:       if (m.y - m.r > canvas.height) meteors.splice(i, 1);
112:     }
113: 
114:     // collision detection
115:     for (const m of meteors) {
116:       // simple AABB‑circle check
117:       const cx = ship.x + ship.w / 2;
118:       const cy = ship.y + ship.h / 2;
119:       const distX = Math.abs(m.x - cx);
120:       const distY = Math.abs(m.y - cy);
121:       if (distX > ship.w / 2 + m.r || distY > ship.h / 2 + m.r) continue;
122:       if (distX <= ship.w / 2 || distY <= ship.h / 2) { playExplosion(); gameOver = true; break; }
123:       const dx = distX - ship.w / 2;
124:       const dy = distY - ship.h / 2;
125:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= m.r * m.r) { gameOver = true; break; }
126:     }
127:     if (!gameOver) score++;
128:   }
129: 
130: function draw() {
131:     // Clear background
132:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
133:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
134:     // Draw starfield
135:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
136:     for (const s of stars) {
137:       ctx.beginPath();
138:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
139:       ctx.fill();
140:     }
141:     // ship as triangle
142:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00a';
143:     ctx.beginPath();
144:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
145:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
146:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
147:     ctx.closePath();
148:     ctx.fill();
149:     // meteors with radial gradient
150:     for (const m of meteors) {
151:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x, m.y, 0, m.x, m.y, m.r);
152:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff7');
153:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#a00');
154:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
155:       ctx.beginPath();
156:       ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
157:       ctx.fill();
158:     }
159:     // score
160:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
161:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
162:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
163:     if (gameOver) {
164:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
165:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
166:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
167:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
168:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
169:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
170:     }
171:   }
172:     // score
173:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
174:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
175:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
176:     if (gameOver) {
177:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
178:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
179:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
180:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
181:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
182:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
183:     }
184:   }
185: 
186:   function loop() {
187:     if (!gameOver) {
188:       update();
189:       draw();
190:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
191:     } else {
192:       draw(); // final frame with overlay
193:     }
194:   }
195: 
196:   // start
197:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
198: })();
